What is MedlinePlus? MedlinePlus is an online health information resource from the National Library of Medicine (NLM) for patients and their families and friends. Learn more about MedlinePlus What is the All of Us Research Program? What is the All of Us Research Program? The All of Us Research Program is a large research program run by the National Institutes of Health (NIH). The goal is to help researchers understand more about why people get sick or stay healthy.
